svg.title: mfe anim render contact sheet (proposal)
svg.desc: The PNG that mfe anim render writes for Claude to look at: a header with the clip, model and check summary; eight frames of a jump in three views (front, side, three-quarter) on a ground grid, each labelled with its time and key name, pinned feet marked; a trajectory strip of hips, foot and hand heights over time with contact bands; and the check report.
svg.text: model Content/Characters/hero.glb (humanoid map: 22/22 required, Mixamo names) · 1.10 s · loop None · root inPlace
leftFoot slides 0.031 m during pin 0.00–0.24 s
ground penetration: none (lowest foot -0.004 m, tolerance 0.01 m)
foot slide: leftFoot 0.031 m during pin 0.00–0.24 s (tolerance 0.02 m) — add a key or pin earlier
joint range: all within limits (closest: LeftLowerLeg flex 105° of 150°)
flips / spikes: none (max angular speed 1210°/s, Spine at 0.24 s)
start/end pose: stand → stand within 2°; root inPlace: hips XZ drift 0.000 m
Proposal (G1c). mfe anim render writes this PNG for Claude to inspect; one row per --views entry, one column per frame (--frames,
default: the key times). Blue triangles mark IK pins; the strip shows the arcs and contacts the checks measure. The far limbs are grey.
The figures are the skinned model in the real tool (lit, unshaded grey material), drawn here as sticks.
